De praktiserende speciallæger (Enheden for Kvalitet I Speciallægepraksis, also known as eKVIS) is a professional unit representing practicing specialist doctors in Denmark [^src1]. The organization participates in the Danish healthcare system's quality management processes by reviewing and providing feedback on clinical quality indicators [^src1]. 

In the [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] report, which documents the quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across Danish regions, eKVIS was consulted regarding the report's quality indicators [^src1]. The organization formally provided no comments ("Ingen kommentarer") to the indicators in this edition of the report [^src1]. This absence of feedback, which was consistent across all five Danish regions as well as eKVIS, suggests a broad consensus or a lack of objections to the current metrics used for evaluating atrial fibrillation care [^src1]. 

As the available corpus only contains this single reference to the organization's review of the atrial fibrillation indicators, further historical or operational details about eKVIS are not documented here.
